response.original_title: Walking in Circles: Shinjuku with Hisayasu Satô: Part 1
response.overview: Hisayasu Satô revisits the locations in Shinjuku where he shot Lustmord (Pleasure Kill), Re-Wind (Celluloid Nightmare), and Love Letter in the Sand (Pervert Ward: Torturing the White Uniform).  From the Volume 1 set by Vinegar Syndrome.
response.tagline: Locations featurette with director Hisayasu Satô
